entries.title: Two Men Vanished From Alcatraz in 1937 (Part 1)
His Trainers Gave Him Rat Poison. He Won Olympic Gold.
He Was Shot Between the Eyes. He Lived 54 More Years.
They Were Told to Lick Their Paintbrushes. The Paint Was Radioactive.
His Body Grew a Second Skeleton
An Iron Rod Went Through His Skull. He Survived.
